description: A folder of images into one tidy PDF: a contact sheet (2–6 columns) or one image per page, on A4 or US Letter, with file names under the images and an optional title and date header. Images are embedded as JPEG thumbnails sized to their place on the page, so the file stays small. Saved next to the first image (or where you say) as proof-sheet.pdf or your-title.pdf. [Pro tool.]

columns.description: Grid: images across (the site offers 2, 3 or 4; default 3).

date.description: Show today’s date in the header.

files.description: Images or folders, in the order they should appear. ~ is your home folder.

layout.description: "grid": a contact sheet. "single": one image per page.

output_path.description: A .pdf path or a folder. Default: the folder of the first image.

page.description: Page size. "fit" (one per page only) matches each image’s shape.

quality.description: Image detail: print 300 dpi, balanced 200 dpi, email 110 dpi (smallest file).

title.description: Optional title at the top of each page (also the file name), e.g. "Client review: round 2".

name: make_proof_sheet
title: Make a proof sheet PDF
